slides.title: Zero conditional
slides.subtitle: General truths and routines
goals: Use **if / when + present, present** for facts.
Contrast it with the first conditional.

slides.title: Form and use

head: Type
Example
rows: If you heat ice, it melts.
If I'm tired, I go to bed early.
If the light is red, press the button.

slides.tip: In zero conditionals **if** can be replaced by **when** with almost no change in meaning.

items.q: If you mix red and blue, you ___ purple.
If you call me tonight, I ___ you the details.
Water ___ if you heat it to 100 °C.
